questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Water has an unusually high specific heat capacity of about 4186 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹. A direct consequence of this is that water:
options: Heats up and cools down very quickly
Heats up and cools down slowly, making it a good coolant and moderator of climate
questions.explanation: A large specific heat means a lot of heat is absorbed for a small rise in temperature, which is why coastal areas have milder climates and why water is used in car radiators.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 10: Thermal Properties of Matter

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The speed of a transverse wave on a stretched string of tension T and linear mass density μ is:
questions.explanation: Tightening a string raises the speed and hence the frequency, while a thicker, heavier string lowers it, which is exactly how a sitar or guitar is tuned.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The nuclear radius R of a nucleus of mass number A is given by R = R₀A^(1/3). It follows from this that the density of a nucleus is:
options: Nearly the same for all nuclei
questions.explanation: Mass goes as A while volume goes as R³, that is also as A, so the two cancel and the density stays around 2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg m⁻³ for every nucleus.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: The second ionisation enthalpy of an element is always greater than the first because:
options: The second electron is farther from the nucleus
The electron must be removed from a positively charged ion, which holds it more tightly
The atom becomes larger after the first ionisation
questions.explanation: After the first electron leaves, the remaining electrons feel a greater effective nuclear charge and the ion shrinks, so more energy is needed each time.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A mixture of chloroform and acetone shows negative deviation from Raoult's law because:
options: The two form hydrogen bonds with each other, making escape into vapour harder
They do not mix at all
The mixture boils below both components
questions.explanation: The new A-B interaction is stronger than A-A and B-B, so vapour pressure falls below the predicted value and both ΔH(mix) and ΔV(mix) are negative.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following complexes can show optical isomerism?
questions.explanation: The three bidentate ethylenediamine rings give a propeller-like arrangement whose mirror image cannot be superimposed, so the d and l forms exist. The others are all symmetrical.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In a woody dicot stem, the dark coloured, non-functional central wood is called:
questions.explanation: Heartwood is blocked with tannins, resins and oils, so it only gives mechanical support. The lighter peripheral sapwood is the part that still conducts water.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 6: Anatomy of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which of the following is considered the most defining property of all living organisms?
options: Growth, since non-living things never grow
Metabolism, since no non-living object shows it
questions.explanation: A mountain and a crystal can grow by accumulation, and mules or sterile worker bees do not reproduce, but no non-living thing carries out metabolism.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 1: The Living World

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The rising phase of an action potential in a neuron is caused by:
options: A sudden influx of sodium ions through voltage gated channels
questions.explanation: Sodium rushing in reverses the membrane polarity to about +30 mV. Potassium then flows out to repolarise the membrane, and the pump restores the resting gradients afterwards.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Thymosin, secreted by the thymus gland, is mainly responsible for:
options: Differentiation of T lymphocytes and cell mediated immunity
questions.explanation: The thymus shrinks with age and thymosin levels fall, which is one reason immunity weakens in old people. Melatonin from the pineal gland is the hormone of the sleep cycle.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 19: Chemical Coordination and Integration
